description: This dataset contains observations of the Timor deer (Rusa timorensis), a species of mammal native to Southeast Asia and Australia. The records include taxonomic information, geographic coordinates, observation dates, and metadata such as identifiers, licenses, and contributors. The semantic profile highlights biodiversity-focused fields, including taxonomic classifications, spatial data (coordinates, uncertainty, and elevation), temporal details (event dates, day, month, year), and quality control flags. Observations span multiple regions, including Indonesia, Australia, and New Caledonia, with coordinates ranging from -34.475 to 0.785 latitude and 0 to 151.053 longitude. The dataset can be used for ecological studies, conservation efforts, and research on species distribution, habitat preferences, and population trends. It also supports biodiversity monitoring and citizen science initiatives.
